snippet.title: Little Ghost : Game Trailer : Sept 22nd release
snippet.description:
Little Ghost: This chill metroidvania maximizes non-linear exploration & puzzle-platforming. Frequent checkpoints, no currency, no combat. Gain friends & abilities. Collectables-as-media; tarot cards, weird podcasts, and songs from over 20 bands; all found within a surreal papercraft world. 

Available on Steam for PC : September 22nd 2026
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587380/Little_Ghost/

Music:
Nehedar "Take It Apart"
GULL "Mouth to Match"
It's Not Night: It's Space "The Mantis and the Cow"
Catie Lausten "CPR"
Jessie Miller "Lazers"
music info: https://www.little-ghost.com/music 

Tarot cards illustrated by Eduardo Alexandrino
Designs by Alan Abbadessa
tarot info: https://www.little-ghost.com/tarot
